question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Get customer's 1st and 2nd preferences
WITH cust_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS pref1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS pref2
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
-- Get entertainer's top 2 styles by strength
ent_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) as rank
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
ent_top2 AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN StyleID END) AS strength1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN StyleID END) AS strength2
    FROM ent_styles
    WHERE rank <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName,
       cp.pref1 AS cust_pref1, cp.pref2 AS cust_pref2,
       et.strength1 AS ent_strength1, et.strength2 AS ent_strength2
FROM cust_prefs cp
JOIN ent_top2 et ON 1=1
JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = et.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
WHERE (cp.pref1 = et.strength1 AND cp.pref2 = et.strength2)
   OR (cp.pref1 = et.strength2 AND cp.pref2 = et.strength1)
